      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "A v2-only option gives the false impression that it hides node operation and protects transaction origin.",
      "quote": "A V2-only option will: not hide the fact that one runs bitcoin node... but it will give the false impression that it does those two things.",

      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "withdrawn by reviewer after documentation clarifications",
      "author_replies": ["c:2440608399", "c:3555608000"],
      "other_replies": ["c:2388794160"],

      "status_by_id": "c:3517995745",
      "status_by_quote": "with this post I would like to withdraw my \"Concept NACK\" and leave it in your capable hands. Concept 0"
    },

      "id": "c:2388454981",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Disallowing v1 makes it more difficult for older v1 nodes to find peers to connect to.",
      "quote": "Further, it will make it more difficult for old nodes to find peers to connect to.",

      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "withdrawn by reviewer along with Concept NACK",
      "author_replies": ["c:2440608399", "c:3555608000"],
      "other_replies": ["c:2388794160"],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:3517995745",
      "status_by_quote": "with this post I would like to withdraw my \"Concept NACK\" and leave it in your capable hands. Concept 0"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:1779484434",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Widespread adoption risks network partitioning and peer exhaustion for legacy nodes running older versions.",
      "quote": "the network partitioning and the lack of peers risks could be imposed on a future minority of users that are running earlier versions of Bitcoin Core.",

      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author restricted the option to outbound connections to eliminate partition risk",
      "author_replies": ["c:2440608399"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:2440608399",
      "status_by_quote": "I've rebased and changed the approach in the PR to have v2 only outbound connections. So there's null partition risk"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3222147684",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "Unresolved destination hostnames delegated to a proxy might be clearnet addresses and mistakenly connected via unencrypted v1 transport.",

      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "addressed in push",
      "author_replies": ["c:4554588949", "rc:3310828084"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:4554588949",
      "status_by_quote": "pushed an update addressing @w0xlt's comments."
    },

      "id": "c:5035178818",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "DNS seeds and static address databases do not set the v2 flag, preventing a cold-start node with v2only from finding any peers.",
      "quote": "Addresses learned via dnsseed right now as well as the static addr databases don't have the v2 flag. And so a node that has v2 as a requirement for its peer selection won't find any peers at all from ",

      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "reviewer agreed with defaulting seed results to v2, addressed via #35766",

      "other_replies": ["c:5035943130", "c:5036801852"],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5036072015",
      "status_by_quote": "Oh good point on the seeds. I agree, that's tidy enough."
    },

      "id": "c:5035178818",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Forcing listen=0 is an anti-feature that deprives the network of listening and v2 connection capacity.",

      "other_replies": ["c:5035943130"],

      "status_by_id": "c:5738174617",

      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Only allow inbound v1 connections that have fRelay=false to address partitioning concerns.",

      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained fRelay=false does not prevent the peer from sending transactions",
      "author_replies": ["c:5738174617"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5738174617",
      "status_by_quote": "fRelay=false only promises that we won't relay transactions to that peer - it doesn't stop the peer from sending transactions to us."
    }

      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": []
    },

      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": []
    }

    {

    }
